tools.name: list_agency_divisions
tools.description: List all Agency divisions and their agent counts

tools.name: list_agency_skills
tools.description: List all 184+ Agency skills available in this workspace
tools.command: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem C:\\antigravity\\.agents\\skills -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'agency-*' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name | Sort-Object"
